sections.shortTitle: Ali Institute of Education Lahore Amendment Ordinance 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIX OF 2015
ORDINANCE XXIX OF 2015
ALI
INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015
An Ordinance to amend the Ali Institute of Education
Lahore Act, 2010
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary 29th September, 2015]
No. Legis: 13-40/2005, dated 29-9-2015.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary to amend the Ali
Institute of Education Lahore Act 2010 (II of 2010) for increasing the scope of
education being imparted at the Institute and for other Purposes.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is
not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be cited as the Ali Institute of Education Lahore
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is

In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:
2. Amendment in section 4 of Act II of
2010.---In the Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act 2010 (II of
2010), in section 4, in subsection (1):
(a) for clause (i),
the following shall be substituted:
"(i) provide
instructions and training in the faculty of education and such other branches
of knowledge as the Board may, with the approval of the Patron given on the
recommendation of a committee constituted by the Government, determine and,
where applicable, subject to the prior approval of the relevant statutory body
of professional education; ;
(b) in
clause (ii), for the words "teachers education , the word "knowledge"
shall be substituted; and
(c) for
clause (iv), the following shall be substituted:
"(iv) hold examinations in the prescribed
manner and, if a person qualifies the examination, award a degree, certificate
and any other academic distinction to the person; .
